caption: The drawing depicts a single clear glass goblet centered on a plain, light beige background. The goblet is rendered with precise details, showing the bowl at the top, which is rounded and transparent, the short stem below it, and the wide, flat foot at the base. Reflections and highlights on the glass are illustrated with subtle shading and hints of white, blue, and gray to create a realistic sense of transparency and light interacting with the glass surface. The goblet is the only object in the composition, and the background is unadorned, making the glass the focal point. The artist's signature, "MAUD HOLME," appears in the lower left corner of the image.
title: Glass
